title: Nuclei Isolation from Human Frozen Liver
author: Sanjay Subramanian
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bhpej5je
materials: Analyze nuclei morphology using hemocytometer and Trypan blue

steps.title: Thaw and Wash Tissue
steps.instruction: Thaw a small tissue sample from frozen preservation medium at room temperature and wash in 1x PBS.

steps.title: Mince Tissue
steps.instruction: Briefly mince the tissue into small chunks using a scalpel and/or razor in a petri dish on ice.

steps.title: Homogenize Tissue
steps.instruction: Homogenize the tissue chunks using a Tissue Grinder Dounce with Pestle A in 500μL to 1mL of ice-cold TST buffer.

substeps.instruction: Use Pestle A (best suited for this protocol).
Ensure thorough homogenization, even after the solution seems sufficiently aqueous, to achieve full dissociation of cellular membranes.

steps.title: Filter and Fix Nuclei
steps.instruction: Filter the suspension through a 70μM cell strainer and bring the total volume up to 5mL with ice-cold ST buffer containing 0.1% PFA.

substeps.instruction: Mix the solution well to ensure the fixative circulates.

steps.title: Centrifuge and Wash Nuclei
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the nuclei at 500g for 5 minutes at 4 °C.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 5 mL ST buffer.

steps.title: Repeat Wash Cycle
steps.instruction: Repeat the centrifugation and resuspension steps (500g for 5min at 4 °C, then resuspend in 5 mL ST buffer).

substeps.instruction: Adjust the final resuspension volume based on the pellet size.

steps.title: Final Filtration
steps.instruction: Filter the solution through a 40μM cell strainer.

steps.title: Adjust Nuclei Concentration
steps.instruction: Adjust the nuclei concentration as needed, targeting 700-1200 cells/μL (specifically 1000 nuclei/μL for the 10x Chromium system).
